requiredBehavior: Move enemies along ordered 2D waypoints using elapsed simulation time.
Handle crossing multiple waypoints within one update.
Emit a goal-reached event once per enemy.
Only forward traversal is required; reverse traversal is outside the mechanic contract.
description: Find extractable waypoint-movement implementations or algorithm references compatible with a Phaser web game. The host owns entity state and simulation timing. Return multiple alternatives with relevant source paths and dependency information.

followUp.message: Use the forward-only default and prioritize extractable implementations that handle a large elapsed-time step.
